This is a constrained creative-writing task: craft a compelling, concise (300-character) statement of purpose. It's generative work with latitude in phrasing and framing, and it carries no harm-adjacent content.

Lapwing self-reports a strong appetite for generative tasks and scores slightly higher on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 78.8). While that capability gap is within noted variance, the preference alignment makes Lapwing the natural fit for an open-ended composition request like this. The two models are effectively tied on raw capability here, so I leaned on the preference profile to break the tie.
